analysis: fixed-grid expression-only PCA40 plus Leiden scan
preprocessing: normalize_total(1e4), log1p, PCA40, matching the A1 expression-space frontier
rare_rule: reference classes with share <5%; predicted clusters with share <= threshold

A1.reference_label_join: exact observation-ID join after removing the documented s1- prefix
A1.scope: single human lymph-node section; scores are conditional on the supplied reference labels
A1.label_provenance_note: The supplied final_annot lineage remains unresolved; label-based scores are conditional on the supplied reference.

D1.reference_label_join: labels stored in the source AnnData observations
D1.scope: second lymph-node section from the same study

Breast.scope: single breast-cancer section; fine labels are subregions and are scored class by class

fine_label.interpretation_note: The labels below 5% sum to a large fraction of the section. Per-class scores are interpretable, but the binary rare-union score is not comparable to a genuinely sparse rare-domain endpoint.
